verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region. The closest items are compliance certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001) and a claim that data 'never leaves our secure servers'; these are adjacent security assurances, not user-selectable residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
